newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB's Dec debentures seen at 2.15 pct - bankers.
newsitem.headline: NCB's Dec debentures seen at 2.15 pct - bankers.

text.p: The coupon rate for Nippon Credit Bank's December bank debentures are likely to be set at 2.15 percent, banking sources said on Tuesday.
This compares with a coupon rate of 1.6 percent for the Industrial Bank of Japan's December bank debentures.
The coupon rate for the NCB's November bank debentures was 2.25 percent.
The difference in the coupon rate between NCB debentures and IBJ debentures would be 0.55 percent, compared to 0.45 percent previously.
A banking source said Nippon Credit Bank was also likely to lower its long-term prime rate by 0.2 percentage points from the previous month to 2.5 percent, a record low.
IBJ announced a cut in its long-term prime rate to 2.5 percent on Monday.
The NCB will officially announce the coupon rate for the December five-year bank debentures and its long-term prime rate at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT).
